ReportLayout.title: ReportLayout
ReportLayout.description: Global persisted page sequence, removed page IDs, and public-hidden page IDs for the Mancom AR Executive Report.

pageOrder.description: Ordered array of valid integer report page IDs.

deletedPages.description: Array of integer report page IDs removed by an Admin from the visible report.

hiddenPages.description: Array of integer report page IDs hidden from public/non-admin viewers by an Admin.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest Admin layout update.

/report_config/{configId}.description: Publicly readable, Admin-writable global report navigation and slide layout configuration.
